TITLE: MGS5 EV: UK SE and Trophy Battery, Range and Equipment Choices
PROPOSED_TITLE: MGS5 EV: UK SE and Trophy Battery, Range and Equipment Choices
PRIMARY_QUERY: MGS5 EV SE vs Trophy specifications
SEARCH_INTENT: Compare the three UK brochure trims and decide whether battery/range or convenience equipment deserves priority in a purchase enquiry.
BUYER_TASK: Shortlist the exact UK trim, avoid treating 64 kWh as a complete equipment description, and request VIN-specific charging documentation.
TARGET_BUYER: Overseas buyers evaluating a UK-reference MGS5 EV offer
WHY_THIS_TOPIC: No MGS5/ES5 matches in supplied repository and recent branch evidence; substantively different from existing MG4/MG ZS hubs.
EXPECTED_DECISION: SE Standard Range for the smaller battery reference; SE Long Range for highest quoted WLTP range; Trophy for listed convenience equipment, not highest quoted range.
